inputs.locator: Decision feature: DAILY_INTRADAY_SIGN_PERSISTENCE_SHARE_TO_PRIOR_20D_MEDIAN. From exactly 24 hourly closes wholly inside the latest complete UTC day, compute 23 close-to-close simple returns and the 22 adjacent return pairs. Count a pair only when both returns have the same non-zero sign, divide by the fixed denominator 22, then divide by the median of exactly the prior 20 complete-day shares. Admit only at or above the frozen threshold. The preceding day's close, zero-pair deletion, later bars, return magnitude, alternate lags, formulas, lookbacks or thresholds are forbidden.

Frozen variants and accounting: lower neighbor 0.8, primary 1.0 and upper neighbor 1.2; Design 2019-2022, historical Validation 2023-2024 and annual folds 2020-2024. Parent and every variant use 250 USDT initial equity, effective 240 USDT whole-lot capacity, eight 30-USDT lots, 0.10 percent fee each side, 0.05 percent adverse slippage each side, next-open fills, unchanged DRA seven-day cooldown and profit-only exits.

Frozen gate set: require exact corpus and parent parity; primary Design and Validation total PnL strictly higher; Validation realized and unrealized non-worse; Validation drawdown delta at most +0.25pp; median and P90 holding non-worse; at least four Validation interventions; at least 3/5 annual total-PnL wins and 4/5 annual drawdown non-worse; positive annual delta concentration at most 60 percent; both neighbors improve Validation total PnL, stay within drawdown tolerance and have adequate support. Every gate must pass.

objective: Evaluate exactly one frozen intraday return-sign persistence DRA V1 entry-admission mechanism on the sealed pre-2025 H1 corpus. Compare the unchanged equal-capital parent with primary 1.0 and frozen 0.8/1.2 neighbors. Retain one prior for a separately frozen hypothesis only if Design, Validation, annual breadth, concentration, drawdown, holding, underwater duration, utilization, realized/unrealized PnL and terminal inventory pass the unchanged declarative gate set; otherwise close the family without tuning. This is a magnitude-neutral historical development proxy, not a formal autocorrelation test, clean OOS, a candidate, a runtime filter or Trading authorization.

performance_case.causal_mechanism: DRA already requires a positive 24-hour close and rising EMA20, but that endpoint can be produced by an orderly directional path or a choppy path with repeated sign reversals. The complete-day adjacent-return sign-persistence share tests whether a more internally coherent positive-momentum path identifies robust entries before the unchanged next-open fill without changing trend horizon, volatility magnitude, jump magnitude, volume, exits or size.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This task may establish only one post-hoc pre-2025 historical mechanism conclusion for exact same-equity DRA V1 with versus without DAILY_INTRADAY_SIGN_PERSISTENCE_SHARE_TO_PRIOR_20D_MEDIAN admission. Historical Validation is not clean OOS and the share is not a formal autocorrelation test. A positive result retains a prior for at most one separately frozen hypothesis; it is not independent alpha, a candidate, a runtime filter or Trading authorization. The task cannot inspect post-2024 outcomes, change a relation, threshold, lookback, sign rule, lag, runner or gate, create a hypothesis or candidate, open OOS, deploy or mutate canonical state.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: The feature is valuable only if it rejects fragile positive-momentum endpoints without merely suppressing participation or moving losses into terminal inventory. The frozen equal-capital screen therefore requires PnL breadth, drawdown non-inferiority, holding tails, underwater duration, utilization, realized-lot support and neighbor stability together.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: The veto can miss profitable entries after choppy accumulation or short-horizon reversal, while historical Bitcoin evidence often finds negative rather than positive first-order dependence. One frozen screen either retains the proxy for one future hypothesis or closes it before another sign rule, lag, OOS source or runtime implementation consumes research capacity.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: Under identical 250 USDT initial equity, effective 240 USDT whole-lot capacity and unchanged DRA V1 economics, admitting signals only when the latest complete day's intraday sign-persistence-share ratio is at or above 1.0 of its prior-20-day median will improve fee-adjusted total PnL in Design and historical Validation while preserving realized and unrealized components and maintaining acceptable drawdown, holding, underwater, annual-breadth and concentration paths.

decision_time.availability_rule: At each unchanged DRA complete-UTC-day decision, all 24 hourly closes wholly inside the just-completed day and every share in the prior 20-complete-day median are known before the next-open fill; the preceding day's close, incomplete day and later return are excluded.
